\[
I=\iiint_{\Omega}\left(\frac{\partial P}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial Q}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial R}{\partial z}\right)\mathrm{d}V

=\iiint_{\Omega}(2x+1)\mathrm{d}V
\]

区域 \(\Omega\) 满足 \(x,y,z\ge 0,\ 2x+y+2z\le 2\)。固定 \(x\in[0,1]\)，截面面积

\[
S(x)=\frac12\cdot 2(1-x)\cdot (1-x)=(1-x)^2
\]

所以

\[
I=\int_0^1 (2x+1)(1-x)^2\mathrm{d}x
=\int_0^1 (1-3x^2+2x^3)\mathrm{d}x

\]
